name: Symmetric Voxel Grid
definition: An arrangement of features in the voxel grid that is symmetric with respect to the scene center, ensuring that features at the boundaries of regions are shared by neighboring decoders to avoid discontinuities.
summary: Symmetric Voxel Grid is a feature arrangement strategy that ensures continuity at region boundaries by mirroring features across the scene center, avoiding discontinuities without the model size overhead of overlapping regions.
